description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different reasoning categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of Samples” and utilizes a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10,000, with tick labels displayed at 10⁰, 10¹, 10², 10³, and 10⁴.  Each category is represented by a single, light blue bar. The “Mathematical Reasoning” bar is the tallest, reaching a value of approximately 7025, while “General Reasoning” reaches 1709. “Natural Scene Reasoning” is represented by a bar of length 413, followed by a bar for “Physical Reasoning” at 232.  “Logical Puzzle Reasoning” shows a value of 91, and the shortest bar, representing “Chemical Reasoning”, has a value of 49. The bars are arranged in descending order of height, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
